items.title: Is AlliedPath online?
items.answer: Yes. Classes are held live online, so students can join from any country.

items.title: Will I get a certificate?
items.answer: No. AlliedPath only teaches and mentors. Your degree or diploma comes from your own college or university.

items.title: Who can join?
items.answer: Students of allied health programs, working allied health professionals who want to strengthen their knowledge, and allied health faculty who want to teach.

items.title: Can I try a class before I pay?
items.answer: Yes. Book a free demo class from this page. You meet a faculty member and see how a session works, with no payment and no commitment.

items.title: What does it cost?
items.answer: Fees are shown on each program and batch when announced. If a fee is not shown yet, we share it with you personally before you decide anything.

items.title: How do I pay, and can I get a refund?
items.answer: You can pay online once you reserve a seat. Our refund and cancellation policy is on the Terms & refunds page.

items.title: I live outside India. Will the class time suit me?
items.answer: Batch times are shown in India time and in your own time zone. Tell us your country when you register and we will try to find a batch that fits.

items.title: How is this connected to ResearchMed Connect?
items.answer: AlliedPath is a teaching and mentoring platform from the ResearchMed Connect team. For research and publication help, ResearchMed Connect continues as before.
